parameters.description_en:
Yes, the history of conversations and tool invocations. The latest message is at the end (index n-1), and the oldest message is at the beginning (index 0).
It must be in the form of user-assistant pairs, with a total count of 2*n+1, and the length of the latest question should not exceed 1000 characters.
The length of the historical conversation is limited to 100.
parameters.description_zh:
是	对话历史以及工具调用历史。最新的消息在最尾（index为n-1），最旧的消息在最头（index为0）。
限制必须是user-assistant成对的形式，条数为2*n+1条，并且最新的提问的长度不超过1000个字符长度。
历史对话长度限制在100以内。

parameters.description_en: The content of the files involved in the current Q&A. It is recommended to use the return value of the ContextualRetrieval interface as input.
parameters.description_zh: 当前问答涉及到的文件内容，推荐使用 ContextualRetrieval 接口的返回作为入参。

element_fields.description_en: The identifier of the file in the dataset.
element_fields.description_zh: 对应File存在于Dataset中的标识符。
element_fields.help_en: The identifier of the file in the dataset
element_fields.help_zh: 对应File存在于Dataset中的标识符
element_fields.name: object_id

element_fields.description_en:
The URI of the file.
The format of an OSS URI is oss\://${bucketname}/${objectname}. ${bucketname} is the name of an OSS bucket in the same region as the current project. ${objectname} is the file path.
The format of a PDS URI is pds\://domains/${domain}/drives/${drive}/files/${file}/revisions/${revision}.
element_fields.description_zh:
文件URI。
OSS地址规则为oss://${bucketname}/${objectname}，其中${bucketname}为和当前项目处于同一地域的OSS Bucket名称，${objectname}为文件路径。
PDS地址规则为pds://domains/${domain}/drives/${drive}/files/${file}/revisions/${revision}。
element_fields.name: uri

element_fields.description_en: The URI path of the OSS file. This parameter is used only when the URI is a PDS address.
element_fields.description_zh: OSS文件的URI路径。仅在URI为PDS地址时使用。
element_fields.help_en: The URI path of the OSS file. This parameter is used only when the URI is a PDS address
element_fields.help_zh: OSS文件的URI路径。仅在URI为PDS地址时使用
element_fields.name: oss_uri

element_fields.description_en: The media type of the file.
